Label Taxonomic Names in Italics

Source: R/labellers.R
label_taxonomy.Rd

Format the names of microorganisms in axis or legend labels in italics, as is the convention in microbiology. Family and genus names in the microorganisms data set of the AMR package are italicised, and so are species and subspecies names that follow a genus or an abbreviated genus (such as S. aureus); other words are kept as they are.

Usage

label_taxonomy(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Values, such as the breaks of an axis.

...

Not used, allows this function to be used as a labeller.

Value

An expression vector if any taxonomic name was found, otherwise x as character.

Details

Use this function for the labels of any plotting direction, e.g. x.labels = label_taxonomy or category.labels = label_taxonomy. It requires the AMR package.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("AMR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  label_taxonomy(c("Escherichia coli", "Other", "S. aureus"))
  
  bacteria <- data.frame(name = c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Other"),
                         n = c(25, 18, 6))
  bacteria |>
    plot2(name, n, x.labels = label_taxonomy)
}
